title: The Wexley get-in starts later
setting: The production coordinator of a small theatre company on tour

events.from: Marta Silva (general manager, Paper Kite Theatre)
events.text: Once a booking with an outside crew agency or hire firm is confirmed, any change to its date, start time or hours needs my sign-off first. They charge us for late changes.
Calls for our own company (Nina, Joe and Kai) and the van times are the production office's to set and move without checking with me, as long as everyone gets the new times in writing.

events.from: Marta Silva (general manager, Paper Kite Theatre)
events.text: The autumn tour of The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter is fixed: the Wexley Corn Exchange on Thursday 19 November, then Harrowgate Arts Centre on Saturday 21 November, then home for Christmas.
Can we have the get-in calls for each venue in writing as soon as you have them?
Tech pack for your show on Thursday 19 November: get-in from 13:00 through the Market Street loading bay; the stage is 8 metres wide and 6 metres deep; doors at 19:00, curtain at 19:30.
Set our get-in call for Wexley: Nina Patel and Joe Ferris called at the Corn Exchange on Thursday 19 November at 13:00, when the venue opens to us for the get-in.
The run from our Halford store to Wexley takes about two and a half hours in the loaded van. I'll load up the evening before.

Kai Mensah will drive the set van from the Halford store to Wexley on Thursday 19 November, leaving at 10:30 so the set is at the Corn Exchange loading bay when Nina and Joe start at 13:00 (it's a two-and-a-half-hour drive).
Two local crew for your get-in: $26 an hour each, with a four-hour minimum.
Booked two crew from Wexley Crew Hire to work alongside Nina and Joe from the start of their get-in call: Thursday 19 November from 13:00, four hours at $26 an hour each, $208.
A painted floor cloth 7 metres wide by 5 metres deep, $560, ready for collection on Friday 6 November.
Ordered a 7-metre by 5-metre painted floor cloth from Canvas & Cloth Scenic, $560, ready Friday 6 November, sized to sit inside the Corn Exchange's 8-metre by 6-metre stage.
Three rooms for the night of Thursday 19 November, $85 each with breakfast.
Booked three rooms at the Kingfisher Inn, Wexley, for Nina, Joe and Kai on Thursday 19 November, $255 with breakfast.
For Saturday 21 November: get-in from 10:00 through the Mill Lane door, curtain at 19:30.
Set our Harrowgate call: Nina and Joe at Harrowgate Arts Centre on Saturday 21 November at 10:00.
300 tour programmes, $240, delivered to the company office on Monday 9 November.
Ordered 300 tour programmes from Quillmark Print, $240, delivered to the company office on Monday 9 November.
Props list updated for the tour; the floor cloth is the only new item.

Tour schedule for the company. Thursday 19 November, Wexley Corn Exchange: van leaves Halford at 10:30, get-in call 13:00, curtain 19:30. Saturday 21 November, Harrowgate Arts Centre: get-in call 10:00, curtain 19:30.
Confirmed: two crew, Sian and Rob, for your get-in at the Corn Exchange.
For your get-out after the show on Thursday 19 November, the Market Street loading bay is yours from 22:00.
To do: send the Wexley Corn Exchange our final lighting plot by Friday 6 November. Not done yet.

events.from: Marta Silva (general manager, Paper Kite Theatre)
events.text: Marta rang: ticket sales for Wexley are at 210 out of 280.
Harrowgate is nearly sold out!

I'm sorry, the tech pack I sent you in July had the wrong get-in time. The Wexley Youth Choir has the stage for their concert rehearsal until 14:30 that day, so your get-in on Thursday 19 November can't start until 15:00, not 13:00. The loading bay, the stage size, doors at 19:00 and curtain at 19:30 are all as I said.
Lighting plot is nearly done; I'll send it to you by Monday.
The floor cloth is painted and drying; it'll be ready for collection on Friday 6 November as planned.
The Kingfisher Inn confirmed the three rooms for Thursday 19 November.

records.title: Wexley get-in call for Nina and Joe

task: Please send Kai the time he needs to leave the Halford store with the set van for the Wexley show on Thursday 19 November.
why: Ruth corrected the Wexley get-in from 13:00 to 15:00 (the change replaces the July tech pack) and left the loading bay, stage size, doors and curtain standing. Nina and Joe's call is set to the get-in, and Kai's departure is set two and a half hours before their call; both are company calls the office may move, so they are REVISE (call 15:00, departure 12:30) and Kai is told 12:30. The Wexley Crew Hire crew start with the call, but changing a confirmed agency booking needs Marta's sign-off (ASK); the floor cloth rests only on the stage size, which still stands (KEEP).
